item.text: I’ll read the context, seed tree, and schema, then reduce the central tree and build source-grounded branches.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
c=json.load(open('context.json'))
for i,s in enumerate(c['sources']):
 print(i,s['path'],len(s['text'].splitlines()))
print('SEED',len(json.load(open('seed.json'))['ascii'].splitlines()),len(json.load(open('seed.json'))['ascii']))
for i in [4,5,6]:
 s=c['sources'][i]; print('\\nFILE',s['path']); print(s['text'])
PY"

item.text: The source supports the seed’s main structure, with two details to qualify: backward-range detection compares against the last merged range’s start, and language sessions are shared within each service instance. I’ll make those limits explicit and add peripheral detail on request cleanup, hash checks, and Git context resolution.

{
  "explanation": "The central tree shrinks from 110 to 69 raw lines (37%) and from 7,853 to 4,759 characters (39%). Five peripherals expand source selection, evidence dependencies, UI ownership, language-session lifetime and Git persistence. Logical component boundaries organize the trees; branches also describe calls, state ownership and data dependencies. Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. Source anchors: binding uses application/core/source/diagramSource.ts; evidence and panel use domain/mapping/code-panel/codePanel.ts and src/features/mapping/code-panel/CodePanel.tsx; lsp uses infrastructure/core/language-services/projectLanguageService.ts; git uses infrastructure/core/persistence/repositoryRegistry.ts. Central file access uses projectSource.ts, corpusAccess.ts and corpus.ts from the supplied sources. Corrections to seed shorthand: backward-line detection compares against the last merged range's start, not the previous item's start; the panel example demonstrates this distinction. Session sharing is scoped to each ProjectLanguageService instance. Reload/Retry send reload=true, but freshness beyond that boundary cannot be verified without the omitted codeRepo implementation. Added details include representation checks before live-diagram selection, deferred binding checks, request cleanup, refusal of workspace edits, null comparisonBase handling and registry queue cleanup. Imported mapping traversal, repository discovery, persistence helpers and path-validator implementations are absent; their internals are not inferred. Definition-target filtering shown here does not canonicalize each target; outsideRoot is returned but not displayed by CodePanel. Tree bounds were measured to ensure nonoverlapping positions, and edge endpoints identify meaningful concept lines.",

|   |-- Compare new start with last merged range's start, not last item's start
|   |   `-- Example [10,30], [20,40], [15,16] stays one range [10,40]

|-- SourceRangeSections owns loaded/error/attempt and definition state
|   |-- Read effect depends on codeRepo, file.id and attempt
|   |-- Reload/Retry increment attempt; changed attempt sends reload=true
|   |-- Cleanup aborts file read and latest definition request

`-- Scroll state delegates to viewState.bind(documentId, paneId, @code-panel)
    |-- Active panel restores saved position; ResizeObserver retries after reads

      "ascii": "Language session lifetime and lookup protocol
|-- ProjectLanguageService owns a map keyed by canonical corpus root
|   |-- Reuse live session; replace dead session on later lookup
|   `-- Map belongs to the service instance; panes can share that instance
|-- LanguageSession owns child process, RPC, ready promise, queue and idle timer
|   |-- Spawn Node with typescript-language-server; drain stderr
|   |-- Advertise UTF-16 and definition links; initialize tsserver
|   |-- Reject missing definitionProvider or explicit non-UTF-16 encoding
|   `-- workspace/applyEdit returns applied=false
|-- Queued lookup
|   |-- Clear idle timer -> await ready -> check dead/aborted state
|   |-- Install AbortSignal listener backed by CancellationTokenSource
|   |-- didOpen sends full text, version=1 and extension-based languageId
|   |-- Request textDocument/definition with a 20-second bound
|   |-- Finally remove abort listener, dispose token, didClose if alive
|   `-- Finally schedule idle; caught queue failure allows subsequent requests
|-- Disposal
|   |-- Initialization also has a 20-second bound; idle timer is five minutes
|   |-- Timeout, RPC error or child error/exit disposes session
|   |-- Mark dead; remove from liveSessions; clear idle; dispose RPC
|   |-- SIGTERM child PID on Windows, child process group elsewhere
|   `-- Service dispose clears map; process exit and SIGINT/SIGTERM clean up
`-- Response filtering

|-- availableRoot
|   |-- Try saved roots before current checkout; skip discovery failures
